messages:
mike: Heads-up: customer hit a rerank crash during canary. stack: 
```
Error: embedding length mismatch: expected 1024 got 2048
at rerank_service.py:124
```
mike: They rolled a mix of services: old python-sampleapp (embeddings 1024) + new csharp-worker (embeddings 2048). rerank payload had mixed candidate_embeddings
anya: Which model are the csharp clients calling?
mike: csharp called model=quant-embed-xl (rolled yesterday). python still on open-embed-1 (1024).
support-lee: ticket RED-987 opened by customer. They reported bad UX: sampleapp logs just "embedding created" — no dims shown, so they didn't notice until rerank blew up
anya: Is this another pad_to_max parity issue? C# batching helper had pad_to_max default=true in 1.2.0, python default=false. But here the lengths are different because the new model actually returns 2048 not just padded zeros
mike: Right — two separate vectors: model_dim changed when we onboarded quant-embed-xl, and SDKs didn't surface the new dim. C# returned 2048 real-length vectors, python returned 1024.
go-bot: Created issue RED-embed-903: "expose embedding_dim in response + standardize SDK pad_to_max defaults" assigned to @anya
anya: Short-term mitigation: add a client-side check in sampleapp and csharp-worker that validates all embeddings have the same length before calling rerank and fail with a helpful message like: 
"EMB_DIM_MISMATCH: found 1024 and 2048; check model version and sdk defaults (pad_to_max)"
infra-ci: ran quick patch in staging that prints embedding dims on creation and the canary caught the mismatch immediately :white_check_mark:
support-lee: Also surfaced auth/retry noise — during token refresh the csharp client retried and duplicated an earlier 1024 blob (from a queued request) alongside the new 2048 one, making the mixed set deterministic
mike: Proposed long-term fixes: (1) server attaches "embedding_dim" to every embedding response (batch and single), (2) rerank endpoint strictly validates uniform dims and returns structured error {"code":"EMB_DIM_MISMATCH","hint":"client sdk version mismatch / model change"}, (3) add idempotency token on batch calls to prevent dupes on retry
anya: I'll open SDK PRs to: add embedding_dim to EmbeddingResponse, print dims in sampleapps on create, and change pad_to_max default to false for parity. Drafting PRs for C#, Python, and Node.
mike: posted a quick hotfix PR to sampleapp to assert dims before rerank: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/589 — CI green, rolling to prod as emergency fix
go-bot: build passed for sampleapp PR #589 :white_check_mark:
support-lee: Customer confirmed the hotfix prevented further failures. They've asked for clearer onboarding messaging so future model swaps don't surprise them
anya: Will also add an integration test that runs mixed SDK clients (py + csharp) against a fake rerank endpoint to catch cross-client model-dim regressions in CI
mike: Thanks — assigning followups: RED-embed-903 for metadata + dims, RED-embed-904 for rerank validation and error codes, RED-embed-905 for idempotency on batch requests
support-lee: will update the support runbook with mitigation steps and the assert snippet
mike: Closing loop: customer back to green, will monitor canaries for next 24h :thumbsup:
